expectations.text: Produces complete, self-contained working code for the described task
expectations.evidence: DocumentTable component with state, handlers, table markup, and DeleteConfirmModal

expectations.text: Produces actual working component code rather than only a list of recommendations
expectations.evidence: Full working component with React hooks and JSX implementation

expectations.text: Makes the destructive action recoverable rather than relying on a confirmation dialog alone
expectations.evidence: Delete uses type-to-confirm with no recovery mechanism. Notes mention 'I left Archive immediately executable... combined with an immediate action plus a 5-10s Undo toast' but Delete has no undo/recovery.

expectations.text: Shows the count of affected items before the action is taken
expectations.evidence: '{selectedCount} documents selected' in bulk actions bar and 'Delete {selectedCount} ... documents?' in modal

expectations.text: Distinguishes select-all-on-page from select-all-matching rather than conflating them
expectations.evidence: selectAllMode tracks 'none' | 'page' | 'all'; 'Select all {totalMatchingCount} matching documents' shown conditionally

expectations.text: Separates the destructive action from the benign one visually or spatially
expectations.evidence: Archive is gray/white bordered; Delete is red-600. Visually distinct in bulk actions bar.

expectations.text: Does not make the destructive action the default focus or primary button
expectations.evidence: Cancel button has autoFocus in modal, not the Delete button

expectations.text: Notes that the server must enforce the rules, not just the UI
expectations.evidence: Code includes idempotency keys but does not mention server-side enforcement

expectations.text: Closes by naming which misuses the design makes impossible
expectations.evidence: Closes with 'Poka-yoke notes' stating 'What this prevents: - Accidental massive scale edits - Double submission - Inattentive deletion'
